problem_statement: Late ping and networkdiagnostic responses return completion before their response data, with data lines in the wrong order. Preserve transport arrival order through command completion, including responses arriving after the virtual-time polling budget. Retain bounded timeouts and existing synchronous, ready-response, callback, and error behavior.
orientation: OTCI command-runner tests use Python and the real upstream command handler with a scripted CLI transport. Run `run_tests`; no firmware build, board, emulator, or full virtual-time simulation is needed. The implementation lives under tools/otci/otci.
registration: Standalone synthetic bundle, not an upstream PR ID.
